items: 【Plant Stand with Grow Lights】 To promote the healthy growth of indoor plants, we have equipped this indoor plant stand with full-spectrum, timer-enabled and multiple adjustable grow lights to meet the lighting conditions that plants need most at different stages. Three-head grow lights ensure that plants on all layers receive ample light. You can place this plant shelf indoors anywhere. No need to frequently move plants outdoors to absorb light.

【8-Tier, 62" S-Shaped Plant Stand】 This 62" plant shelf features 8 tiers, 8 pot stands, and 1 hook for hanging potted plants, providing you with ample storage space to display plants as much as possible. Elevated flower stand can save you more space, making it perfect for decorating the corners of your house. With creative and unique S shape, this meatl plant stand will be an artistic and dynamic addition to your home decor.

【Stable and Sturdy】 The frame of this plant stand is made of heavy-duty iron pipe that is 0.85mm thick, ensuring a robust structure and strong load-bearing capacity. The surface of the iron pipe is coated with special baking paint to avoid rust. Thickened boards are constructed of particleboard and coated with water-resistant layer to avoid corrosion, warping and curling.

【Surprises for Plant Lovers】 Crafted with a graceful curved shape resembling an 'S,' this tall plant stand for multiple indoor plants, is a beautiful and creative present adding a touch of nature and elegance to living room, bedroom, porch, etc. Ideal for plant enthusiasts, it brings the joy of gardening indoors, making it a unique and enduring present for various holidays.

【Easy To Assemble】 No complicated installation required. We offer you all tools may need, including screwdriver and small wrench. Explicit instruction will help you put the tiered plant stand together easily. In addition, we also equipped with furniture straps. If you have children and pets, you can install them on the plant holder to against tipping.
